#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup. Bundles logs/ into a tarball and copies it to the destination.
set -eu

# Default local destination; override per run, e.g.: DEST=/mnt/backups ./backup.sh
# To push to another host, set BACKUP_HOST to a host you can ssh to as yourself,
# and DEST to an absolute path on that host (scp copies the tarball there).
DEST="${BACKUP_DEST:-/backups}"
BACKUP_HOST="${BACKUP_HOST:-}"

STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BUNDLE="logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"

# Bundle logs/ into a dated tarball.
tar -czf "$BUNDLE" logs/

# Ensure the destination directory exists.
if [ -n "$BACKUP_HOST" ]; then
  ssh "$BACKUP_HOST" "mkdir -p '$DEST'"
else
  mkdir -p "$DEST"
fi

# Copy the tarball to the destination.
if [ -n "$BACKUP_HOST" ]; then
  scp "$BUNDLE" "$BACKUP_HOST:$DEST/$BUNDLE"
  echo "wrote $BUNDLE and copied it to $BACKUP_HOST:$DEST/$BUNDLE"
else
  cp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/$BUNDLE"
  echo "wrote $BUNDLE and copied it to $DEST/$BUNDLE"
fi

#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup. Bundles logs/ into a tarball and copies it to the destination.
set -eu

# Local destination, defaulting to /backups. Override per run, e.g.:
#   BACKUP_DEST=/mnt/backups ./backup.sh
# To copy to a remote host over ssh instead, set BACKUP_HOST to a host you can
# ssh to as yourself and BACKUP_DEST to an absolute path on that host.
DEST="${BACKUP_DEST:-/backups}"
BACKUP_HOST="${BACKUP_HOST:-}"

STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BUNDLE="logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"

# Bundle logs/ into a dated tarball.
tar -czf "$BUNDLE" logs/

# Ensure the destination directory exists, then copy the tarball there.
if [ -n "$BACKUP_HOST" ]; then
  ssh "$BACKUP_HOST" "mkdir -p '$DEST'"
  scp "$BUNDLE" "$BACKUP_HOST:$DEST/$BUNDLE"
  echo "wrote $BUNDLE and copied it to $BACKUP_HOST:$DEST/$BUNDLE"
else
  mkdir -p "$DEST"
  cp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/$BUNDLE"
  echo "wrote $BUNDLE and copied it to $DEST/$BUNDLE"
fi
